title: Digvijaya Singh marches for religion and relevance
description: Congress veteran Digvijaya Singh is currently taking part in a nearly 1,000-kilometre march on foot from Ujjain in Madhya Pradesh to Ayodhya in Uttar Pradesh, against the alleged embezzlement of donations at the Ram Temple. The yatra comes at a time when 79-year-old Singh, Madhya Pradesh’s former Chief Minister, finds himself on the sidelines of the Congress’ politics in the State
